grades.name: Grade 3
grades.intro: Grade 3 is the year of multiplication and division. Master the facts, then use them for area, rounding and word problems.

grades.subject: math
grades.name: Grade 4
grades.intro: Grade 4 is the year of multi-digit multiplication, long division and fractions. Build fluency with big numbers, then use it for fractions, decimals, measurement and angles.

grades.subject: math
grades.name: Grade 2
grades.intro: Grade 2 builds strong number sense: facts within 20, adding and subtracting within 100 and 1000, place value, money, time and measuring. Short lessons and lots of practice make it stick.

grades.subject: math
grades.name: Grade 5
grades.intro: Grade 5 brings fractions and decimals to full strength: add fractions with unlike denominators, multiply and divide fractions and decimals, and find volume. Short lessons with step-by-step examples, then lots of practice.

grades.subject: math
grades.name: Grade 6
grades.intro: Grade 6 is the bridge to algebra: ratios, rates and percents, dividing fractions, negative numbers, expressions and equations, area and surface area, and statistics. Short lessons with step-by-step examples, then lots of practice.

grades.subject: math
grades.name: Grade 1
grades.intro: Grade 1 builds the base for all of math: adding and subtracting within 20, tens and ones, counting to 120, telling time, measuring and shapes. Short lessons with pictures, then lots of practice.

grades.subject: math
grades.name: Kindergarten
grades.intro: Kindergarten is where math begins: counting to 20 and to 100, writing numbers, comparing groups, adding and taking away within 10, and naming shapes. Short lessons with lots of pictures, then fun practice.

grades.subject: maths
grades.name: Year 4
grades.intro: Year 4 is the year of the times tables: pupils learn all facts up to 12 × 12 for the Multiplication Tables Check. They also work with 4-digit numbers, fractions and decimals, area and perimeter, and the 12- and 24-hour clock.

grades.subject: maths
grades.name: Year 6
grades.intro: Year 6 brings together everything from primary school maths ready for the KS2 SATs: long multiplication and division, fractions, decimals and percentages, ratio, algebra, angles, area and volume, and statistics.

grades.subject: maths
grades.name: Year 3
grades.intro: Year 3 builds confidence with numbers to 1,000, the 3, 4 and 8 times tables, column addition and subtraction, fractions, money, time and measuring. Short lessons with pictures, then lots of practice.

grades.subject: maths
grades.name: Year 5
grades.intro: Year 5 takes numbers to a million and decimals to three places: long and short multiplication, short division, fractions and percentages, measuring angles with a protractor, area and perimeter, and line graphs.

grades.subject: maths
grades.name: Year 2
grades.intro: Year 2 builds number sense to 100: place value, number bonds, adding and subtracting 2-digit numbers, the 2, 5 and 10 times tables, fractions, money, time and shapes. Short lessons with pictures, then lots of practice.

grades.subject: maths
grades.name: Year 1
grades.intro: Year 1 is where maths begins: counting to 100, number bonds to 10 and 20, adding and subtracting within 20, halves and quarters, money, time and shapes. Picture-based lessons and practice for 5 and 6 year olds.

grades.subject: maths
grades.name: Year 7
grades.intro: Year 7 is the first year of secondary school (Key Stage 3). Pupils extend their number skills with negative numbers, powers, primes and fractions, start using algebra to write and solve equations, and work with ratio, angles, area, averages and probability.

grades.subject: maths
grades.name: Year 8
grades.intro: Year 8 builds on Year 7 with index laws, standard form, expanding and factorising, equations with unknowns on both sides, straight-line graphs, percentage change, circles, prisms, transformations and combined probability.

grades.subject: maths
grades.name: Year 9
grades.intro: Year 9 completes Key Stage 3 and prepares pupils for GCSE: Pythagoras' theorem, trigonometry, similar shapes, quadratics, simultaneous equations, compound interest, volume of cones and spheres, and scatter graphs.

grades.subject: maths
grades.name: Year 3
grades.intro: Year 3 maths builds strong number skills: numbers beyond 10 000, adding and subtracting with regrouping, multiplication facts for 3, 4, 5 and 10, fractions, money, time and chance. Great preparation for NAPLAN numeracy.

grades.subject: maths
grades.name: Year 5
grades.intro: Year 5 maths moves to decimals with more than 2 places, percentages, factors and multiples, multiplying and dividing larger numbers, angles in degrees, area and perimeter, and line graphs. Great preparation for NAPLAN numeracy.

grades.subject: maths
grades.name: Year 4
grades.intro: Year 4 maths builds on Year 3: multiplication facts to 10 × 10, decimals with tenths and hundredths, equivalent fractions, larger numbers, money, time with am and pm, angles, symmetry and chance.

grades.subject: maths
grades.name: Year 6
grades.intro: Year 6 maths gets students ready for high school: integers, prime and square numbers, fractions, decimals and percentages, order of operations, the area of a rectangle, angles, the Cartesian plane and probability.

grades.subject: maths
grades.name: Foundation
grades.intro: Foundation is the first year of school (called Kindergarten, Prep, Pre-primary, Reception or Transition in different states). Maths starts with numbers to 20, seeing small amounts at a glance, adding and taking away, sharing, patterns, comparing, days and times, shapes, position and sorting, with a picture in almost every question.

grades.subject: maths
grades.name: Year 1
grades.intro: Year 1 maths: numbers to 120, tens and ones, adding and subtracting within 20, skip counting, sharing, patterns, measuring, shapes, position, data and chance, with a picture in almost every question.

grades.subject: maths
grades.name: Year 2
grades.intro: Year 2 maths: numbers to 1000, addition facts to 20, adding and subtracting 2-digit numbers, twos and doubling, equal groups, money, halves, quarters and eighths, time to the quarter-hour, shapes and graphs.

grades.subject: maths
grades.name: Year 7
grades.intro: Year 7 maths starts high school: square numbers and roots, prime factorisation, fractions, decimals and percentages, integers, ratios, algebraic expressions and equations, area and volume, angles with parallel lines, data and probability.

grades.subject: maths
grades.name: Year 8
grades.intro: Year 8 maths: index laws, recurring decimals and irrational numbers, percentages and profit, expanding and factorising, linear equations and graphs, Pythagoras' theorem, circles, rates, time zones, congruent triangles, sampling and probability.

grades.subject: math
grades.name: Grade 3
grades.intro: Grade 3 math in Ontario: numbers to 1000, adding and subtracting with regrouping, multiplication facts for 2, 5 and 10, fair shares and fractions, money and making change, time, measurement, data and probability. Great practice for the Grade 3 EQAO assessment.

grades.subject: math
grades.name: Grade 6
grades.intro: Grade 6 math in Ontario: fractions, decimals and percents, integers, ratios and rates, equations and inequalities, area of polygons, angles, the Cartesian plane, data, probability and financial literacy. Great practice for the Grade 6 EQAO assessment.

grades.subject: math

grades.subject: math
grades.name: Grade 7
grades.intro: Grade 7 math in British Columbia: integer and decimal operations, order of operations, fractions, decimals, ratios and percents, two-step equations, linear relations, circles, volume, the Cartesian plane, transformations, circle graphs, probability and financial percentages. Great practice for the Grade 7 FSA.

grades.subject: math

grades.subject: math

grades.subject: math
grades.name: Grade 4

grades.subject: math
grades.name: Grade 5

grades.subject: math
grades.name: Grade 7
grades.intro: Grade 7 math in Ontario: powers and square roots, fractions, decimals and percents, integers, GCF and LCM, proportional reasoning, linear patterns, expressions and equations, circle graphs, probability, dilations, circles, surface area and volume, and exchange rates.

grades.subject: math
grades.name: Grade 8
grades.intro: Grade 8 math in Ontario: scientific notation, square roots and real numbers, percents, integer and fraction operations, proportional relationships, linear relations, equations and inequalities, scatter plots, probability, scale drawings, angle properties, the Pythagorean theorem and interest.

grades.subject: math
grades.name: Kindergarten
grades.intro: Kindergarten math in British Columbia, with a picture in almost every question: numbers to 10, ways to make 5, making 10, change in quantity, repeating patterns, equal and not equal, comparing length, mass and capacity, shapes, concrete graphs, likelihood and Canadian coins.

grades.subject: math

grades.subject: math

grades.intro: Grade 8 math in British Columbia: squares, cubes and roots, percents, proportional reasoning, fraction operations, expressions, two-step equations, linear relations, surface area and volume, the Pythagorean theorem, views and nets, central tendency, probability and best buys.

grades.subject: math
grades.name: Grade 9
grades.intro: Mathematics 9 in British Columbia: exponent laws, rational numbers, polynomials, multi-step linear equations, linear relations and graphs, similar shapes and scale, statistics in society, and budgets.

grades.subject: maths

grades.subject: maths
grades.name: Primary 2

grades.subject: maths
grades.name: Primary 3
grades.intro: Primary 3 maths in Singapore: numbers to 10 000, 4-digit addition and subtraction, multiplication tables of 6 to 9, division with remainder, equivalent fractions, money, compound units, time and the 24-hour clock, area and perimeter, angles, parallel lines and bar graphs.

grades.subject: maths
grades.name: Primary 4
grades.intro: Primary 4 maths in Singapore: numbers to 100 000, rounding, factors and multiples, multiplication and division, mixed numbers and fractions of a set, decimals to 3 places, area and perimeter, angles, symmetry, nets, tables, line graphs and pie charts.

grades.subject: maths
grades.name: Primary 5
grades.intro: Primary 5 maths in Singapore: numbers to 10 million, order of operations, fractions and division, mixed numbers, decimals and unit conversion, percentage, discount and GST, rate, area of triangles, volume, angles, triangles and special quadrilaterals.

grades.subject: maths
grades.name: Primary 6
grades.intro: Primary 6 maths in Singapore: dividing fractions, percentage increase and decrease, ratio, algebra, circles, volume, angles in composite figures and average, with PSLE-style word problems and the model method. Great practice for the PSLE.

grades.subject: maths
grades.name: Secondary 1
grades.intro: Secondary 1 maths in Singapore (G3 Mathematics, formerly Express): primes, HCF and LCM, integers, approximation, ratio, percentage, rate and speed, algebra, linear equations and graphs, angles and polygons, area and volume. Short lessons and O-Level style practice.

grades.subject: maths
grades.name: Secondary 2
grades.intro: Secondary 2 maths in Singapore (G3 Mathematics, formerly Express): expansion and factorisation, algebraic fractions, simultaneous and quadratic equations, inequalities, proportion and map scales, congruence and similarity, Pythagoras' theorem and trigonometry, volume, statistics and probability.

grades.subject: maths

grades.intro: Secondary 3 maths in Singapore (G3 Mathematics, O-Level): indices and standard form, the quadratic formula, fractional equations, inequalities, graphs of quadratic, power and exponential functions, coordinate geometry, similar figures, sine and cosine rules, bearings, radians and circle properties.

grades.subject: maths
grades.name: Secondary 4
grades.intro: Secondary 4 maths in Singapore (G3 Mathematics, O-Level year): sets and Venn diagrams, matrices, vectors, problems in three dimensions, cumulative frequency and box plots, standard deviation and probability of combined events. O-Level style practice with full worked answers.

grades.subject: math
grades.name: Grade 7
grades.intro: Grade 7 is the year of negative numbers and proportional thinking: add, subtract, multiply and divide integers and rational numbers, solve two-step equations and inequalities, work with percents, scale drawings, circles and probability. Short lessons with step-by-step examples, then lots of practice.

grades.subject: math
grades.name: Grade 8
grades.intro: Grade 8 is the year of linear equations and functions: solve equations, find slope, graph lines, solve systems, and use exponents, roots, the Pythagorean theorem, transformations and volume. Short lessons with step-by-step examples, then lots of practice.

grades.subject: math
grades.name: Algebra 1
grades.intro: Algebra 1 is the first high school math course: solve equations and inequalities, work with functions, graph lines and solve systems, use exponents and exponential models, then factor and solve quadratics. Short lessons with step-by-step examples, then lots of practice.

grades.subject: math
grades.name: Geometry
grades.intro: Geometry is the high school course on shape and proof: reason about lines and angles, prove triangles congruent and similar, use the Pythagorean theorem and trigonometry, and work with circles, coordinates and volume. Short lessons with step-by-step examples, then lots of practice.

grades.subject: math
grades.name: Algebra 2
grades.intro: Algebra 2 builds on Algebra 1: complex numbers, polynomial and rational functions, radicals, inverse functions, exponential and logarithmic functions, trigonometric functions and the normal distribution. Short lessons with step-by-step examples, then lots of practice.

grades.subject: math
grades.name: Precalculus
grades.intro: Precalculus prepares students for calculus: rational functions and asymptotes, trigonometric identities and equations, inverse trigonometric functions, complex numbers in polar form, vectors and matrices, the binomial theorem, conic sections, counting and expected value. Short lessons with step-by-step examples, then lots of practice.

grades.subject: math
grades.name: 國小一年級
grades.intro: 國小一年級數學（108課綱）：100 以內的數、數數與順序、加法與減法的意思、基本加減法、二位數加減、算式與等號、認識錢幣、比長短、日期與時間、認識形狀、分類與整理。每個單元100題練習，題目短、圖多，附解答。

grades.subject: math
grades.name: 國小二年級
grades.intro: 國小二年級數學（108課綱）：1000 以內的數、加減直式（進位、退位）、加減應用與估算、錢幣、乘法的意義和九九乘法、分裝與平分、兩步驟問題、單位分數、公分和公尺、容量重量面積、幾時幾分、年月日、平面和立體形狀、分類。每個單元100題練習，附解答。

grades.subject: math
grades.name: 國小三年級
grades.intro: 國小三年級數學（108課綱）：10000以內的數、加減直式、乘法與除法、兩步驟應用問題、分數與一位小數、數線與毫米、公升與毫升、公斤與公克、時間、角、正方形和長方形、圓、面積、表格與規律。每個單元100題練習，附解答。

grades.subject: math
grades.name: 國小四年級
grades.intro: 國小四年級數學（108課綱）：一億以內的數、多位數乘除直式、概數與四捨五入、假分數與帶分數、等值分數、二位小數、角度與量角器、垂直與平行、三角形與四邊形、面積與周長、體積、時間與24小時制、併式與四則運算、長條圖與折線圖。每個單元100題練習，附解答。

grades.subject: math
grades.name: 國小五年級
grades.intro: 國小五年級數學（108課綱）：兆到千分位、因數與倍數、約分通分與異分母分數、分數和小數的乘除、百分率與折扣、公畝公頃與公噸、三角形與四邊形的面積、扇形、線對稱、正方體和長方體的體積與表面積、柱體與錐體、平均與分配律、折線圖。每個單元100題練習，附解答。

grades.subject: math
grades.name: 國小六年級
grades.intro: 國小六年級數學（108課綱）：質因數分解、最大公因數與最小公倍數、分數和小數的除法、比與比值、速度、基準量與比較量、放大縮小與比例尺、圓周長與圓面積、柱體體積與表面積、數量關係、雞兔與年齡問題、圓形圖與可能性。每個單元100題練習，附解答。

grades.subject: math
grades.name: 國中七年級
grades.intro: 國中七年級數學（108課綱）：正負數與數線、絕對值、整數和分數的四則運算、指數與科學記號、質因數分解、一元一次方程式、二元一次聯立方程式、坐標平面、比例式與正反比、一元一次不等式、三視圖與線對稱、統計圖表與平均數、中位數、眾數。每個單元100題練習，附解答。

grades.subject: math
grades.name: 國中八年級
grades.intro: 國中八年級數學（108課綱）：乘法公式、多項式的運算、平方根與根式運算、畢氏定理與距離公式、因式分解（提公因式、乘法公式、十字交乘）、一元二次方程式、數列與級數、一次函數、角與平行線、多邊形內角和、三角形全等與性質、平行四邊形與特殊四邊形、累積次數與相對次數。每個單元100題練習，附解答。

grades.subject: math
grades.name: 國中九年級
grades.intro: 國中九年級數學（108課綱）：連比、相似形與三角形相似、平行線截比例線段、特殊直角三角形、弧長與扇形面積、圓的性質與切線、圓周角、三角形的外心、內心與重心、證明與推理、空間中的線與平面、表面積與體積、二次函數的圖形與最大最小值、盒狀圖與四分位距、機率。每個單元100題練習，附解答。

grades.subject: math
grades.name: Algebra II
grades.intro: High school Algebra II practice for Texas: parent functions and inverses, systems of three equations and linear-quadratic systems, parabolas and quadratic inequalities, square root, cubic, cube root, absolute value and rational functions, exponential and logarithmic functions, complex numbers, polynomials, rational expressions, radicals and data models, with worked answers.

grades.subject: math
grades.name: Precalculus
grades.intro: High school Precalculus practice for Texas: composition, inverse, piecewise and step functions, end behavior, asymptotes and discontinuities, the unit circle, trigonometric graphs, identities and equations, the Law of Sines and Cosines, vectors, parametric and polar equations, conic sections, sequences and series, and polynomial and rational inequalities, with worked answers.

grades.subject: math
grades.name: Kindergarten
grades.intro: Kindergarten practice for Texas: counting and numbers to 20, one more and one less, comparing, making numbers to 10, adding and subtracting within 10, counting to 100, coins, shapes and solids, comparing length and weight, picture graphs and money choices, with a picture on almost every question.

grades.subject: math
grades.name: Grade 1
grades.intro: Grade 1 practice for Texas: numbers to 120, comparing and ordering, tens and ones, making 10, facts and word problems within 20, skip counting, coins, shapes and solids, halves and fourths, measuring length, time to the half hour, graphs and money choices, with pictures on almost every question.

grades.subject: math
grades.name: Grade 2
grades.intro: Grade 2 practice for Texas: place value to 1,200, comparing and ordering, adding and subtracting within 1,000, coins, equal groups, fractions, shapes and solids, measuring length, area, time to the minute, graphs and money sense, with pictures on almost every question.

grades.subject: math
grades.name: Grade 1
grades.intro: MATATAG Math 1 practice with pictures: shapes, counting and numbers to 100, ordinal numbers, adding and subtracting, measuring with non-standard units, pictographs, patterns, halves and quarters, Philippine money, turns, time and the calendar, competency by competency.

grades.subject: math
grades.name: Grade 4
grades.intro: MATATAG Math 4 practice: angles, triangles and quadrilaterals, perimeter, numbers up to 1,000,000, the four operations and the MDAS rules, fractions, unit conversions, symmetry and reflections, tables and line graphs, patterns, number sentences and decimals, competency by competency.

grades.subject: math
grades.name: Grade 7
grades.intro: MATATAG Math 7 practice: polygons and angle pairs, percentages, money and rates, rational numbers, roots and irrational numbers, sets, unit conversions, volumes of cylinders and pyramids, statistics, integers, algebraic expressions and equations, scientific notation and probability, competency by competency.

grades.subject: maths
grades.name: Grade R
grades.intro: CAPS Grade R Mathematics practice (Reception Year, Foundation Phase): counting to 10, number symbols and names, comparing and ordering, first to tenth, adding and taking away to 10, story sums, sharing and halves, patterns, position, shapes and objects, time, comparing length, mass and capacity, and sorting, topic by topic.

grades.subject: maths
grades.name: Grade 1
grades.intro: CAPS Grade 1 Mathematics practice (Foundation Phase): counting to 100, numbers to 20, tens and ones, number bonds, adding and subtracting to 20, word problems, grouping and sharing, halves and quarters, rand coins and notes, patterns, shapes, position, time, measuring and data, topic by topic.

grades.subject: maths
grades.name: Grade 2
grades.intro: CAPS Grade 2 Mathematics practice (Foundation Phase): numbers to 200, place value, odd and even, adding and subtracting to 99, word problems, multiplication and division by 2, 5 and 10, fractions, money, patterns, shapes and symmetry, position, time, measuring and data, topic by topic.

grades.subject: maths
grades.name: Grade 3
grades.intro: CAPS Grade 3 Mathematics practice (Foundation Phase): numbers to 1 000, place value, adding and subtracting to 999, multiplication and division with 2, 3, 4, 5 and 10, fractions, money, patterns, shapes and symmetry, position and maps, time, length, mass and capacity, perimeter and area, and data, topic by topic.

grades.subject: maths
grades.name: Grade 4
grades.intro: CAPS Grade 4 Maths practice: whole numbers to 10 000, addition and subtraction, multiplication and division, common fractions, money and rates, patterns and number sentences, 2-D shapes, 3-D objects, symmetry, maps, length, mass, capacity, time, temperature, perimeter and area, and data handling, topic by topic.

grades.subject: maths
grades.name: Grade 5
grades.intro: CAPS Grade 5 Maths practice: whole numbers to 6 digits, rounding off, 5-digit addition and subtraction, multiplication and division by 2-digit numbers, multiples and factors, common fractions and mixed numbers, money, rate and ratio, patterns and number sentences, 2-D shapes, angles, 3-D objects, transformations, maps, length, mass, capacity, time, perimeter, area and volume, and data handling, topic by topic.

grades.subject: maths
grades.name: Grade 6
grades.intro: CAPS Grade 6 Maths practice: whole numbers to 9 digits, multiplication and division by 3-digit numbers, prime numbers, HCF and LCM, fractions, decimal fractions, percentages, money, rate and ratio, patterns and number sentences, 2-D shapes, angles, 3-D objects, enlargements and reductions, coordinates, length, mass, capacity, time, perimeter, area and volume, and data handling, topic by topic.

grades.subject: maths
grades.name: Grade 7
grades.intro: CAPS Grade 7 Maths practice (Senior Phase): whole numbers, prime factorisation, HCF and LCM, ratio and rate, financial maths with VAT and simple interest, exponents, integers, fractions, decimals and percentages, patterns, functions, algebraic expressions and equations, graphs, angles, triangles and quadrilaterals, 3-D objects, transformations, area, surface area and volume, and data handling, topic by topic.

grades.subject: maths
grades.name: Grade 8
grades.intro: CAPS Grade 8 Maths practice (Senior Phase): prime factors, ratio and proportion, hire purchase, compound interest and exchange rates, integers, laws of exponents, scientific notation, fractions and decimals, patterns, functions, algebraic expressions and equations, graphs, parallel lines, triangles, quadrilaterals, transformations, area of circles, volume of prisms, the theorem of Pythagoras, and data handling, topic by topic.

grades.subject: maths
grades.name: Grade 9
grades.intro: CAPS Grade 9 Maths practice (Senior Phase): real numbers, compound interest, hire purchase, commission and exchange rates, laws of exponents, scientific notation, patterns, functions, products of binomials, factorisation, equations, linear graphs, parallel lines, similar and congruent triangles, quadrilaterals, transformations, views of 3-D objects, area, surface area and volume of cylinders, the theorem of Pythagoras, scatter plots and probability, topic by topic.

grades.subject: maths
grades.name: Grade 10
grades.intro: CAPS Grade 10 Mathematics practice (FET Phase): surds, factorisation, algebraic fractions, exponents, number patterns, equations and inequalities, trigonometric ratios, special angles and graphs, linear, quadratic, hyperbolic and exponential functions, Euclidean and analytical geometry, finance and growth, statistics, measurement and probability, topic by topic.

grades.subject: maths
grades.name: Grade 11
grades.intro: CAPS Grade 11 Mathematics practice (FET Phase): rational exponents and surds, the quadratic formula, the nature of roots, quadratic inequalities, quadratic patterns, equations of lines and inclination, quadratic, hyperbolic, exponential and trigonometric functions, reduction formulae, identities and general solutions, the sine, cosine and area rules, circle theorems, depreciation and effective interest rates, probability and statistics, topic by topic.

grades.subject: maths
grades.name: Grade 12
grades.intro: CAPS Grade 12 Mathematics practice for the NSC (matric): sequences and series, sigma notation, inverse functions and logarithms, annuities and loans, the factor theorem, differential calculus (limits, first principles, rules, tangents, cubic graphs, optimisation), compound and double angles, problems in 3D, circles in analytical geometry, proportionality and similarity, regression and correlation, and counting and probability, topic by topic.

grades.subject: mathe
grades.name: Klasse 3
grades.intro: Mathe Klasse 3: Zahlen bis 1000, Runden, Kopfrechnen, schriftliche Addition und Subtraktion, Einmaleins, Multiplizieren und Dividieren mit Rest, Sachaufgaben, Geld, Längen, Gewichte, Uhrzeit, Körper und Achsensymmetrie, Zahlenfolgen, Diagramme und Wahrscheinlichkeit. Zu jedem Thema 100 Übungsaufgaben mit Lösungen zum Ausdrucken.

grades.subject: mathe
grades.name: Klasse 4
grades.intro: Mathe Klasse 4: Zahlen bis 1 Million, Runden und Überschlagen, schriftliche Addition, Subtraktion, Multiplikation und Division, Rechengesetze und Klammern, Brüche im Alltag, Sachaufgaben, Längen, Gewichte und Rauminhalte mit Komma, Geld, Zeit und Kalender, Maßstab, Umfang und Flächeninhalt, parallel und senkrecht, Würfel und Quader, Diagramme sowie Kombinatorik und Wahrscheinlichkeit. Zu jedem Thema 100 Übungsaufgaben mit Lösungen zum Ausdrucken.

grades.subject: mathe
grades.name: Klasse 5
grades.intro: Mathe Klasse 5: natürliche Zahlen und Stellenwerte, Runden und Schätzen, negative Zahlen, Addieren, Subtrahieren, Multiplizieren und Dividieren, Terme und Rechengesetze, Potenzen, Teiler und Primzahlen, Brüche und Anteile, Größen umrechnen, Sachaufgaben und Kombinatorik, Strecken und Geraden, Koordinatensystem, Winkel, Symmetrie, Flächeninhalt und Umfang, Volumen und Oberfläche von Quadern, Häufigkeiten und Diagramme sowie Terme mit Variablen. Zu jedem Thema 100 Übungsaufgaben mit Lösungen zum Ausdrucken.

grades.subject: mathe
grades.name: Klasse 6
grades.intro: Mathe Klasse 6: Brüche erweitern, kürzen, vergleichen, addieren, subtrahieren, multiplizieren und dividieren, gemischte Zahlen, Dezimalzahlen und periodische Dezimalzahlen, Rechnen mit Dezimalzahlen, Prozente, Rechnen mit negativen Zahlen, Zuordnungen und Dreisatz, Terme und Gleichungen, Kreise und Kreisdiagramme, Dreiecke und Vierecke, Flächeninhalt von Parallelogramm und Dreieck, Daten und Wahrscheinlichkeit sowie Sachaufgaben mit Brüchen und Dezimalzahlen. Zu jedem Thema 100 Übungsaufgaben mit Lösungen zum Ausdrucken.

grades.subject: mathe
grades.name: Klasse 7
grades.intro: Mathe Klasse 7: rationale Zahlen ordnen und mit ihnen rechnen, Prozentrechnung, prozentuale Veränderung, Zinsrechnung, proportionale und antiproportionale Zuordnungen, Terme umformen, lineare Gleichungen und Gleichungen in Sachaufgaben, Winkel an Geradenkreuzungen, Winkelsummen in Dreiecken und Vielecken, Dreiecke konstruieren, besondere Linien im Dreieck, Flächeninhalt von Vierecken, Prismen, Kennwerte und Boxplots sowie Wahrscheinlichkeit mit Baumdiagrammen. Zu jedem Thema 100 Übungsaufgaben mit Lösungen zum Ausdrucken.

grades.subject: mathe
grades.name: Klasse 8
grades.intro: Mathe Klasse 8: Potenzen und Zehnerpotenzen, Quadratwurzeln und reelle Zahlen, Ausmultiplizieren und Ausklammern, binomische Formeln, Bruchterme und Bruchgleichungen, lineare Funktionen, Geradengleichungen aufstellen, lineare Gleichungssysteme grafisch und rechnerisch lösen, Gleichungssysteme in Sachaufgaben, Kongruenzsätze, Satz des Thales, Kreisumfang und Kreisfläche, Zylinder sowie mehrstufige Zufallsexperimente. Zu jedem Thema 100 Übungsaufgaben mit Lösungen zum Ausdrucken.

grades.subject: mathe
grades.name: Klasse 2
grades.intro: Mathe Klasse 2: Zahlen bis 100, vergleichen und ordnen, plus und minus bis 20 und bis 100, Ergänzen, Malaufgaben verstehen, das kleine Einmaleins, Geteiltaufgaben, Sachaufgaben, Geld, Längen, Uhrzeit, Flächen und Körper, Symmetrie, Zahlenmauern und Muster sowie Strichlisten und Diagramme. Zu jedem Thema 100 Übungsaufgaben mit Lösungen zum Ausdrucken.

grades.subject: mathe
grades.name: Klasse 1
grades.intro: Mathe Klasse 1: Zahlen bis 10 und bis 20, Zahlen vergleichen, zerlegen und ergänzen, plus und minus bis 10 und bis 20, Rechnen über die 10, Verdoppeln und Halbieren, Rechengeschichten, Geld, Längen, Uhrzeit, Formen und Körper, Lage und Richtung, Muster sowie Strichlisten und Tabellen. Zu jedem Thema 100 Übungsaufgaben mit Bildern und Lösungen zum Ausdrucken.
